objective: Reejecutar exclusivamente el backfill ISCAM de 130QRO 08/08/2026 despues de R15B y certificar de forma fail-closed 233021.00 / 57 tickets / 159 PAX / delta 0.

queries.name: qro_0808_post_r15b_final
queries.sql:
WITH r AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(CAST(ISNULL(ventas_total,0) AS decimal(19,4))) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(tickets_total,0) AS bigint)) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax_total,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.vw_Comercial_KPIs_Diarios_v2_Runtime
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-08' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-09'
), d0 AS (
  SELECT numero_ticket,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(importe_neto,0) AS decimal(19,4))) venta,
         MAX(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM dbo.Comercial_Inteligencia_VentasDetalleProducto
  WHERE unidad_negocio_id='130QRO'
    AND fecha_operacion>='2026-08-08' AND fecha_operacion<'2026-08-09'
    AND ISNULL(activo,1)=1 AND ISNULL(es_kpi_valido,1)=1
  GROUP BY numero_ticket
), d AS (
  SELECT CAST(ISNULL(SUM(venta),0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas,
         COUNT_BIG(*) tickets,
         SUM(CAST(ISNULL(pax,0) AS bigint)) pax
  FROM d0
)
SELECT CAST(ISNULL(r.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_runtime,
       CAST(ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) ventas_detalle,
       CAST(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas,0) AS decimal(19,4)) delta_ventas,
       ISNULL(r.tickets,0) tickets_runtime,
       ISNULL(d.tickets,0) tickets_detalle,
       ISNULL(r.tickets,0)-ISNULL(d.tickets,0) delta_tickets,
       ISNULL(r.pax,0) pax_runtime,
       ISNULL(d.pax,0) pax_detalle,
       ISNULL(r.pax,0)-ISNULL(d.pax,0) delta_pax,
       1 / CASE WHEN ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-ISNULL(d.ventas,0))<=0.05
                  AND ISNULL(r.tickets,0)=ISNULL(d.tickets,0)
                  AND ISNULL(r.pax,0)=ISNULL(d.pax,0)
                  AND ABS(ISNULL(r.ventas,0)-233021.00)<=0.05
                  AND ISNULL(r.tickets,0)=57
                  AND ISNULL(r.pax,0)=159
                THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS gate_pass
FROM r CROSS JOIN d

constraints: El check posterior debe fallar si no queda delta 0
